authorization: 2026-09-15 user: continue using current patients; ranking fixed at zero; historical design-selection bias excluded
sampling: One patient-multiplicity vector per replicate, stratified by the five original outer folds; shared across all refits, queries and evaluation roles
partitions: Original outer folds and original stratified inner 80/20 partitions remain fixed; every copy of a patient remains in the same partition
early_stopping: Patient-multiplicity-weighted likelihood on original inner-validation partition; patience20 and original maximum500 epochs
censoring: Re-estimated from each bootstrap outer-training risk set before recency filtering; same fitted nuisance estimate for paired apparent/original-development comparisons
primary: 500 bootstrap out-of-fold performance replicates including refitting and evaluation-patient sampling; percentile intervals conditional on fixed folds and model specification
optimism: For each fold, bootstrap-development apparent performance minus performance of the same refitted model on original outer-development patients; subtract the mean signed difference from corresponding original-model development apparent performance
optimism_target: Foldwise development apparent performance; never subtract optimism again from held-out cross-validation performance
precision: Report Monte Carlo SE of mean optimism, quantile rank uncertainty and first-half/second-half endpoint differences; no result-driven stopping or extension
not_estimated: formal confidence interval for the optimism-corrected estimator
